en_title: VisionQuest Release Schedule Reveals Early Premiere for Episode 1
subtitle: 幻视重启
opus_summary: 漫威公布《VisionQuest》播出安排，首播提前一天至10月13日。全剧共八集，前三周每周更新两集，最后两集分别上线，将为《旺达幻视》三部曲收尾。

paragraphs.en: Marvel has published the full release schedule for VisionQuest , revealing an early premiere for Episode 1.
paragraphs.cn: 漫威公布了《VisionQuest》的完整播出安排，第一集将提前上线。

paragraphs.en: The Vision (Paul Bettany) and Ultron-led (James Spader) Disney+ show's rollout plan materialized on Marvel Studios social media channels today – and it came with a bit of a surprise. Instead of starting its offshoot story on October 14 as originally planned , VisionQuest Episode 1 will arrive tomorrow, October 13, at 6pm PT / 9pm ET.
paragraphs.cn: 这部Disney+剧集由幻视（Paul Bettany饰）和奥创（James Spader饰）领衔，漫威影业今天通过社交媒体公布了播出安排，还带来了一点惊喜。原定于10月14日开播的这部衍生剧，将提前到明天，也就是10月13日太平洋时间下午6点／美国东部时间晚上9点（北京时间10月14日上午9点）上线第一集。

paragraphs.en: It's a one-day-early premiere that Marvel waited to announce until today, and it came with more specific information about the full release plan, too. Those hoping to keep up with VisionQuest can expect two episodes each week until its penultimate episode arrives alone November 3, with the eighth and final episode then arriving one week after that. You can see the full breakdown below.
paragraphs.cn: 漫威直到今天才宣布首播提前一天，同时也公布了更详细的完整播出安排。《VisionQuest》起初每周更新两集，直到11月3日单独上线倒数第二集，再过一周上线第八集，也就是大结局。具体安排如下。
第一集「No Strings」与第二集「Theseus」——10月13日

paragraphs.en: "Vision, rebooted and having escaped from those who sought to weaponize him, has been in hiding," an official synopsis for the show says. "Searching for new meaning, he consults the AI personas embedded in his programming, including Friday, Edith, Jarvis, and the infamous Ultron. His discreet existence ends when a bounty placed on his head thrusts him on the run with Thomas Shepard, a mysterious boy who may be Vision’s son, reincarnate."
paragraphs.cn: 该剧官方剧情简介写道：「幻视重启后，逃离了那些试图将他改造成武器的人，此后一直隐匿行踪。为了寻找新的意义，他向程序中内置的AI人格寻求指引，包括星期五、伊迪丝、贾维斯，以及臭名昭著的奥创。一份针对他的悬赏打破了这份隐秘的生活，迫使他与神秘男孩Thomas Shepard一起踏上逃亡之路。这个男孩可能是幻视儿子的转世。」

paragraphs.en: VisionQuest will wrap up the WandaVision trilogy through the course of the next few weeks. It should provide a nice distraction as Marvel Cinematic Universe fans await the next big event film, Avengers: Doomsday , December 18, 2026.
paragraphs.cn: 在接下来的几周里，《VisionQuest》将为《旺达幻视》三部曲收尾。漫威电影宇宙的粉丝们正在等待下一部重磅电影《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》于2026年12月18日上映，这部剧应该能让他们在等待期间有个不错的消遣。

paragraphs.en: The MCU will then gear up for a quiet year as it works to conclude the Multiverse Saga with Avengers: Secret Wars in December 2027, but that doesn't mean there won't be anything to watch in the months between . While we wait to see how Vision's (mostly) standalone story will flesh out the universe , you can check out IGN's list of 10 streaming shows to keep an eye on in October . You can also check out everything we saw at the Marvel Television and Animation panel at New York Comic Con 2026 .
paragraphs.cn: 此后，漫威电影宇宙将迎来相对平静的一年，并准备在2027年12月以《复仇者联盟6：秘密战争》为多元宇宙传奇收尾。不过，这并不代表在此期间的几个月里没有作品可看。
